_about: Defaults for the larry template: what it builds when client.yaml leaves a template input out.
With every input left out, the template rebuilds the source build's structure (segments, outreach lists, pipeline, windows). Source: spec/10-larry-template.md.

Nothing here names the source client, its people or its products. Segment and outreach names are the source build's; a client changes them in client.yaml (template.react.segments, template.aff_email.outreach).
about: Speed to lead (STL), database reactivation (REACT) and the partner email layer (AFF), copied from our first lender build.
stl_lead_trigger: Facebook Lead Form Submitted (any page, any form)
stl_window: every day, 8 AM to 8 PM in the contact's time zone

segments.name: Past Borrowers
segments.rule: Anyone with a won deal in the client's main sales pipeline (or at its last, closed stage), won more than 90 days ago.

segments.name: Dead Term Sheets
segments.rule: Not won, and reached the quote or offer stage (or later), then was lost, abandoned, or has not moved in 60+ days.

segments.name: Quick App Abandon
segments.rule: Started the short application but did not finish it, or tagged stl:no-response by the STL ladder.

segments.name: Old Ad Leads
segments.rule: Came from a Facebook or Instagram ad (source, attribution or an ad-lead tag), added 90 to 365 days ago, and not in 01-03.

segments.name: Referral Sources
segments.rule: Contacts who refer business rather than buy (agents, brokers, other professionals), by tag or by a 'broker' answer on a form. They get partner outreach, not reactivation.

segments.name: Long Tail
segments.rule: Has an email, added more than 365 days ago, no activity for 365+ days, and not in 01-05.

outreach.name: Tier 1 Referral
outreach.audience: professionals whose clients become your customers
